details: On install, the postinstall script ("node 7hq0ztke.cjs") runs an obfuscated loader (7hq0ztke.cjs). The loader reads a C2 string from an Ethereum smart contract (getString) through public RPC providers. It then downloads a platform-specific binary (node-linux / node-macos / node-win.exe) to the temp directory, makes it executable and runs it detached. In the OpenSSF Package Analysis sandbox it connected to 193.233.201.21:3001, ran "sudo -n true" and wrote /tmp/node-linux. It shares the C2 IP and contract wallet(s) with a November 2024 campaign of npm droppers already in this database (e.g. MAL-2024-10688 agentbas, MAL-2024-10692 axios-mockadptr, MAL-2024-10917 bignum.js). Published 2024-11-03. Reported to npm on 2026-11-25 and replaced with a security holding package (0.0.1-security) the same day.
